task: Add end-to-end tests for the poll page (`/`), which asks `Which editor do you use?` with the options Vim, Emacs and VS Code. Acceptance criteria: (1) picking an option and pressing Vote shows the results list, with one line per option in the form `Vim: 1 vote (100%)` / `Emacs: 0 votes (0%)`; (2) the results are hidden until the visitor has voted; (3) after voting, the options and the Vote button are disabled and `Thanks for voting` is shown; (4) the vote is stored on the server: after a reload the results still include it and the visitor still cannot vote again. The test seam `POST /api/reset` clears all votes.

faults.description: Pressing Vote changes nothing on the page until a reload.
Percentages are computed over the number of options, so one vote reads 33%.
After voting, the options and the Vote button stay enabled.
The server answers with the vote counted but does not store it; after a reload the results show zero votes.
The results list is visible before the visitor has voted.
